content.title: Portable rink rental questions
content.subtitle: A few details help shape the right rental recommendation.

items.question: How much space do portable ice rink rentals need?
items.answer: Space depends on the rink size, surrounding guest flow, skate changing area, barriers, access paths, and any add-ons. Share dimensions or venue plans when requesting a quote.

items.question: Can a portable rink be used indoors or outdoors?
items.answer: Portable rink rentals may be planned for indoor or outdoor venues, but the right setup depends on surface type, access, weather exposure, power, and venue rules.

items.question: How far ahead should we start planning?
items.answer: Start as early as possible for holiday dates and winter weekends. Lead time helps confirm availability, setup windows, add-ons, and venue requirements.

items.question: What add-ons should we ask about?
items.answer: Common add-ons include skate support, attendants, lighting, decor, music, barriers, branding, seating, and warming or hospitality areas.

items.question: What is needed for a quote request?
items.answer: Helpful details include event date, location, indoor or outdoor placement, available space, surface type, guest count, rental duration, and desired add-ons.
